title: Blue Bottle Coffee Alternatives: 5 Subscriptions Like It - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for a Blue Bottle Coffee alternative? Compare five single-origin coffee subscriptions by price, roast, and grind, including one that grinds for you.
body_markdown:
Same rotation, another roaster


### Counter Culture Single-Origin Subscription vs Blue Bottle Coffee


**Best for:** The Blue Bottle subscriber who loves the two-week rotation and is curious what another roaster’s buyers would pick.


[Counter Culture](https://counterculturecoffee.com/products/single-origin-subscription-one-bag) roasts in Durham, North Carolina, and its coffee buyers choose a new seasonal single origin every two weeks. Its site tells you who grew each one. A recent pick was a light-roast Kenyan lot from a third-generation family farm, with notes of blackberry and nectarine. Counter Culture isn’t sold on Cratejoy, so the link goes to the roaster’s own site.


#### What feels familiar


A 12-ounce bag of whole-bean single origin that changes every two weeks, and a schedule you can skip, change, or cancel from your account.


#### What changes


The bag costs less, but one bag alone doesn’t reach Counter Culture’s $30 free-shipping line. Its two-bag plan, $39 for two different coffees, ships free. It ships only within the US, and like Blue Bottle it sells whole beans only.
